Generated from the model types in [`crates/canon/src/model`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/crates/canon/src/model): their doc comments, fields, field types and serde attributes. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/protocol-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types. For what the parts mean together, read [the language](../concepts/protocols.md); for the documents an evaluation reads and writes, see [evaluation documents](./documents.md).

Optional fields: a key left out takes its default; a key written with no value is an error.


## The document

A `protocol/1` source document as written.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

| `protocol` | [`ProtocolHeader`](#protocolheader) | required | — |
| `artifacts` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) to [`Artifact`](#artifact) | optional | — |
| `evidence_kinds` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) to [`EvidenceKind`](#evidencekind) | optional | — |
| `claims` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) to [`Claim`](#claim) | optional | — |
| `obligations` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ObligationId`) to [`Obligation`](#obligation) | optional | — |
| `actions` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ActionId`) to [`Action`](#action) | optional | — |
| `outcomes` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`OutcomeId`) to [`Outcome`](#outcome) | optional | — |

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ProtocolId`) | required | — |
| `revision` | integer, 0 or more | required | — |

## `Action`

A semantically named possibility: what it needs, what authority it requires, what effect it
has and what evidence it may produce (design § 10).

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `precondition` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | optional | — |
| `requires` | list of [`CapabilityRequirement`](#capabilityrequirement) | optional | — |
| `effect` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EffectClass`) | optional | — |
| `may_produce` | list of [`EvidenceProduction`](#evidenceproduction) | optional | — |

## `Outcome`

A legitimate terminal interpretation of a case and what it requires.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `requires` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | required | — |

## `Predicate`

A predicate over evidence and claim values.

The predicate language: a small, total, deterministic expression language (design § 39.2).

A predicate is one of `all`, `any`, `not`, an evidence match by kind and optional result, or a
test on a claim value. Written in source as a map with exactly one of the keys `all`, `any`,
`not`, `evidence` or `claim`; a claim test may add `is`, which defaults to `true`.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `all` | list of [`Predicate`](#predicate) | True when every member is true; true when empty. |
| `any` | list of [`Predicate`](#predicate) | True when some member is true; false when empty. |
| `not` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | — |
| `evidence` | [`EvidenceMatch`](#evidencematch) | — |
| `claim` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) | — |
| `is` | [`Truth`](#truth) | Allowed only beside `claim`. |

## `Truth`

A three-valued truth value. `Unknown` is not `False`.

Written `true`, `false` or `unknown`. A YAML boolean `true` or `false` is read as the same value.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `true` | — |
| `false` | — |
| `unknown` | — |

## Identifiers

An identifier is text. A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). Each kind of identifier is its own type, so one cannot stand in for another. These are the kinds a `protocol/1` document use:

| Type | Identifies |
|---|---|
| `ProtocolId` | Identifies a protocol, independently of its revision. |
| `ArtifactId` | Identifies an artifact a protocol declares. |
| `ClaimId` | Identifies a claim a protocol declares. |
| `EvidenceKindId` | Identifies a kind of evidence a protocol declares. |
| `ObligationId` | Identifies an obligation a protocol declares. |
| `ActionId` | Identifies an action a protocol declares. |
| `OutcomeId` | Identifies an outcome a protocol declares. |
| `CapabilityId` | Names a capability an action requires authority for. |
| `EffectClass` | Names the class of effect an action has. |
